description: See the automatic outreach the platform ran for one of your bounties: how many candidate humans were emailed (with timestamps), how many alerts are still queued, progress toward the delivered-alert target, and how many contacted humans applied or responded. Owner only. Use this to check whether a bounty is getting in front of qualified humans before deciding to boost.
